answer.text:
For fiscal year 2024, Citigroup Inc. reported:

- **Net interest income:** $54,095 million ($54.095 billion)
- **Non-interest revenue:** $27,044 million ($27.044 billion)
- **Revenues, net of interest expense:** $81,139 million ($81.139 billion)

The figures are reported in millions; the revenue total reconciles as **$54,095 million + $27,044 million = $81,139 million**.  
**Source:** Citigroup Inc. 2024 Form 10-K, accession **0000831001-25-000067**, section “Filing Summary,” chunk **88**.
